capabilities: Copy selections as raw Markdown source via the normal copy shortcut
Preserve heading and math delimiters in the clipboard
Expose a command to copy the selection as Markdown source
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Native copy in Live Preview and Reading view drops heading hashes and math fences, so pasted text looks wrong outside Obsidian.
summary: Clipboard fixer that copies selections as raw Markdown source with heading markers and math delimiters intact instead of the rendered preview.
